sentences.text:
T h e applicant was arrested on 29.05.2020 by Police Station- Joura District- Morena (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.360/2020 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 366A,
376, 376 (2)(i) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

In brief, case of the prosecution is that on 11.05.2020 at 7:28 pm father of prosecutrix Machlu lodged a handwritten complaint with Police Station Joura District Morena against present applicant-accused alleging that on 24.04.2020 in the evening at 7 pm present applicant took his daughter-prosecutrix aged about 15 years alongwith him.
On his complaint, Crime No.306/2020 for the offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC was registered against present applicant.
During investigation, prosecutrix was rescued on 12.05.2020.
Her statement under Section 164 CrPC was recorded on the same day in which she has stated that she is studied upto 8th standard.
Thereafter she stopped going to school.
Nobody took her alongwith him.
She went to her Aunty's house due to harassment inflicted by her parents.
Her Aunty told her that her father has lodged a report in regard to her missing.
She does not want to go to her house.
Nobody wrong was happened with her.
On the same day, her statement under Section 161 CrPC was recorded in which also she did not allege against present applicant.
In her supplementary statement, prosecutrix made allegation of committing rape against present applicant.
She was sent for medical examination.
Offence punishable under Section 366, 366A, 376, 376 (2)(i) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act was enhanced.
Applicant was arrested.
New ground raised herein is of prejudice on account of delayed trial since applicant is in custody since 29.05.2020 and trial has not progressed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that since rejection of last bail application on 06.12.2022 more than two months has elapsed.
Applicant is in custody since 29.05.2020 and the trial is moving at snail's pace.
After investigation, chargesheet has been submitted and therefore, further custodial interrogation is no more required.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
There is no possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court, without commenting upon the merits of the case, is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he shall be released on bail.
